svg.text: Eight stages from raw bytes to a reopenable evidence bundle.
Real file bytes, not a sample record.
SHA-256, magic bytes, chunk map, extension
Raw offsets from parsers; Mutagen supplementary;
Apply seeded edits to a copy of the
Pick strategy or default cycle; count, seed,
Execute allowlisted tools inside the OS
Matrix per file × decoder; channels, duration,
Rerun a real signal termination and test the
Two repeats, baseline original, then single-edit-
Preserve the session as portable evidence.
reuse the original SHA-256, seed, strategy, index, region, size limit and metadata limit recorded in reproduction_inputs.
No simulation, no cloud round-trip: the same local generator and the same original bytes produce the same output.
every variant is written to a new UUID file
signals and rejections are observations, not verdicts
cancel terminates the active process group
